name: dsh-link-tui-bridge
description: Cordis plugin installed in dsh-tui profile that exposes a localhost-only HTTP bridge (default 127.0.0.1:8125) so a peer DSH web instance (running dsh-link) can command the local TUI to operate on its DSH host — restart-dsh, install-plugin, read-config, list-profiles, log-tail. Pairs with dsh-link v0.5.0's `tui_command` tool.
